parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, no facility/bathroom restriction, no documented border or screening friction against trans travellers, and healthcare access is universal with state-funded transition care — all climate-positive. Official posture is supportive (pride, apology for past persecution, 2000 sauna ruling), and same-sex conduct has been legal since 1971. Countervailing: hate-crime penalties are framed around sexual orientation, not documented gender identity, so anti-trans recourse is unproven; a 2019 case shows a trans woman held in a men's facility and raped despite the voluntary-placement policy, so custody placement (detention-only) is a real unremedied exposure; and recent scrapping of the anti-bullying protocol and sex-ed signals climate backsliding plus religious social friction. No visitor-service enforcement record and no trans-visitor incidence data leave everyday discrimination undocumented. Sits in the reduced-risk band: documented acceptance with protections, held below 0.85 by unremedied custody practice, absent enforcement evidence and recent rollbacks.
